Job Description And Duties

Why Join DHCS?

The Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) is the backbone of California’s health care safety net. Our success is made possible by the hard work of more than 4,800 DHCS team members and through collaboration with the federal government and other state agencies, counties, and partners for the care of low-income families, children, pregnant women, older adults, and persons with disabilities. This is an exciting opportunity to join our diverse team in the following role. If you are interested in joining our team, apply today!

About this Role:

Under general direction of the Manager II in the Managed Care Mointoring Branch, the Research Data Specialist III (RDS III) serves as a senior research and data expert supporting compliance monitoring required under the Managed Care Final Rule and the broader oversight of the Medi-Cal Managed Care program. The role leads advanced research, analytical, and monitoring activities that inform program enforcement within the managed care delivery system. Positioned within a program division rather than a traditional data unit, the incumbent focuses on coordination, collaboration, and liaison work with the Department’s data and technology partners including the Program Data Reporting Division (PDRD), Health Information Management Division (HIMD), and Enterprise Technology Services (ETS). In partnership with these divisions, the RDS III contributes to the development and refinement of monitoring methodologies, shared data exchange processes, and databases and reporting tools used to track grievances, appeals, audit findings, and corrective action plan outcomes tied to Final Rule requirements. Key responsibilities include translating program needs into clear business requirements, participating in the joint development and validation of monitoring datasets, and interpreting results to support oversight and enforcement. The RDS III identifies anomalies, emerging trends, and potential indicators of non-compliance, elevating issues to program leadership when necessary. The position also provides leadership, consultation, and training to staff and collaborates closely with Medi-Cal managed care plans (MCPs), other governmental agencies, and internal partners to ensure accurate, consistent, and meaningful reporting. The RDS III documents methodologies and findings and produces high-quality reports, dashboards, and presentations that communicate monitoring results and support program decision-making.

This position has been advertised as limited term and is expected to last 12 months. This limited term position may be extended up to 24 months if supported by workload or may become permanent if workload becomes permanent.
